## 1 · The data

We first import the daat about Americans worrying about their work being automated.

```{r data}
aiPerception <- read.csv("inputs/americans-worry-work-being-automated.csv")
str(aiPerception)

```

Then we import some exceptionally extensive dataset of voyager

```{r data}
url <- paste0(
  "https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?",
  "format=text",
  "&COMMAND=%27-31%27",
  "&OBJ_DATA=%27NO%27",
  "&MAKE_EPHEM=%27YES%27",
  "&EPHEM_TYPE=%27OBSERVER%27",
  "&CENTER=%27500%40399%27",
  "&START_TIME=%272017-01-01%27",
  "&STOP_TIME=%272024-01-02%27",
  "&STEP_SIZE=%271%20y%27",
  "&QUANTITIES=%2720%27",
  "&CSV_FORMAT=%27YES%27"
)

raw_data <- readLines(url)

start <- which(raw_data == "$$SOE") + 1
end   <- which(raw_data == "$$EOE") - 1

voyager <- read.csv(
  text = paste(raw_data[start:end], collapse = "\n"),
  header = FALSE,
  strip.white = TRUE
)

voyager <- voyager[, 1:4]

names(voyager) <- c(
  "date",
  "date_julian",
  "distance_au",
  "radial_velocity_km_s"
)

voyager$year <- as.integer(substr(trimws(voyager$date), 1, 4))

write.csv(voyager, "voyager1_distance.csv", row.names = FALSE)

voyager
```



## 2 · Plotty plotty plotty

```{r scatter-raw}
aiPerception$Day <- as.Date(aiPerception$Day)

library(ggplot2)

all_adults <- subset(
  aiPerception,
  Entity == "All working adults"
)

ggplot(
  all_adults,
  aes(x = Day, y = Very.worried)
) +
  geom_line(
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "darkred",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Americans very worried about work being automated",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Very worried (%)",
    caption = "Source: Our World in Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r scatter-raw}
voyager$delta <- voyager$radial_velocity_km_s

voyager <- voyager[, c("date", "year", "delta")]

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(voyager, aes(x = year, y = delta)) +
  geom_line(
    colour = "darkblue",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "darkblue",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Voyager 1 distance from Earth",
    subtitle = "Geocentric distance reported as delta",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Distance (AU)",
    caption = "Source: NASA/JPL Horizons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r scatter-raw}
library(dplyr)

aiPerception$Day <- as.Date(aiPerception$Day)
aiPerception$year <- as.integer(format(aiPerception$Day, "%Y"))

worry_yearly <- aiPerception |>
  filter(Entity == "All working adults") |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    worry = mean(Very.worried, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

Preparing Voyager

```{r scatter-raw}
voyager_data <- voyager |>
  select(year, delta) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    delta = as.numeric(delta)
  )
```

```{r scatter-raw}

combined <- merge(
  worry_yearly,
  voyager_data,
  by = "year"
)

combined

```
```{r scatter-raw}

cor(
  combined$delta,
  combined$worry,
  use = "complete.obs"
)


linear_model <- lm(worry ~ delta, data = combined)

summary(linear_model)

```


```{r scatter-raw}

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(combined, aes(x = delta, y = worry)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    colour = "darkred"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = year),
    nudge_y = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The Voyager Effect",
    subtitle = "American automation anxiety increases as Voyager 1 moves away",
    x = "Voyager 1 distance from Earth (AU)",
    y = "Americans very worried (%)",
    caption = "Sources: NASA/JPL Horizons and Gallup/Our World in Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r scatter-raw}
overfit_model <- lm(
  worry ~ poly(delta, 3, raw = TRUE),
  data = combined
)

combined$prediction <- predict(
  overfit_model,
  newdata = combined
)
```


```{r scatter-raw}
ggplot(combined, aes(x = delta, y = worry)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    colour = "darkred"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = prediction),
    colour = "darkblue",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = year),
    nudge_y = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The Voyager Effect",
    subtitle = "Cubic model of deep-space distance and automation anxiety",
    x = "Voyager 1 distance from Earth (AU)",
    y = "Americans very worried (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
